pattern: proxy finish LIGHT (proxy_finish.py stage_light + proxy_finish_light.py): the frozen Pixal3D sheet proxy kept as generated (geometry + texture), made watertight, decimated, baked, optionally reposed with bones

config.fit_side_length_why: NOT applied (deviation from the unit note, measured): the sheet SIDE view is drawn ~0.9x the FRONT view's scale (eye height 13 px side vs 14-15 px front; side height 5.29 vs front 5.87 u; a body-only registration of the proxy's side silhouette onto the sheet side mask peaks at 92-95 px/u, floor-consistent at 95, not 100). The proxy's side proportions already equal the sheet's: length / height 6.22 / 5.85 = 1.063 vs sheet 5.76 / 5.39 = 1.069 (proxy panel numbers). The gate's +8.4 % compares the side length with the FRONT height; fitting it would squash Y by 7.7 % (head and snout included: proxy eye-to-snout-tip 0.69 u x1.036 = 0.715 u = the sheet side view's 64 px / 0.9 scale = 0.715 u)

refloor.why: sheet_proxy floored the proxy's ground SHADOW plate behind the hind legs (z 0 at y 2.9); the hind paws (y 0.4..1.45) stood on a tilted plate at z 0.179 (the front paws at z 0.27 on the same plate tilted 0.05 u/u up toward the front). Floor at the hind-paw contact, then x1.0359 to the sheet front height 5.87

config.midline_x_why: the body's mirror plane to x 0: raw head mirror plane x 0.250 (best-plane search on the head z > 4.2, p99 0.028 u), eye texel centres x -0.162 / 0.633 (mid 0.236), snout tip x 0.243, body slabs z 4.0..5.8 mid 0.24..0.26; x1.0359 after refloor = 0.259

dense.why: head: snout, eyes, jaw line, horn-scale crest (stage frame: snout tip (0, -3.22, 4.39), eyes (+-0.41, -2.51, 4.65), crest top z 5.87)
face: snout tip, both eyes, cream jaw / mouth line held densest

cuts.why: the EXTRA front leg (+x): Pixal3D read the sheet side view's staggered near / far front legs as TWO front legs per side (6 legs: front pairs at y ~-1.6 and ~-0.6 in the stage frame, both vertical, separated by a 0.05..0.2 u gap at z 0.5..1.1 and merged into the shoulder above z ~1.2). The rear pair (B) is removed below z 1.25; the front pair (A, the sheet's near leg, paws at y -1.9 / -2.0) is kept
the same extra front leg on -x
the extra leg's forward toes (+x, y -1.32..-1.0, z <= 0.4) under the kept leg's heel (A ends at y -1.30 at z 0.65)

the proxy's ground SHADOW plate behind the hind legs (dark lum ~20 sheets x -1.95..1.52, y 1.91..3.22, z -0.19..-0.08 after refloor, plus the step at y 1.5..1.9 up to z 0.03): Pixal3D modelled the sheet's drawn floor shadow

a hook-shaped shadow-plate remnant fused beside the -x hind paw (x -1.97..-1.5, y 0.17..0.93, z 0.02..0.33 in the v1 preview low) that fell inside the paw planform; the paw itself stays inside x >= -1.30 at z 0.4

v1.1 TAIL (orchestrator V1.1 (1); artist 'Drakescale Beast v2 tail note': extend tails by duplicating the generated tail segments, never a tube): the proxy's own tail below z 1.45 / behind y 1.5 (its swung 45 deg run, 0.47 u to -x at the tip, 3.15 u chain) is removed; the kept root (z >= 1.45, centre x -0.1) carries on as light.segment_array copies of its own root segment along the sheet curve on x = 0. y >= 1.5 keeps the hind heels (back edge y 1.40 at z 0.1..1.1, stage-1 side projection) untouched

light.cuts_why: (1) the extra front-leg pair Pixal3D invented (6 legs) and (2) the drawn ground shadow it modelled as thin dark plates (lum ~20, 0.03..0.06 u thick, 96 soup pieces) under the whole body: tiled boxes (0.05 u grid, greedy rectangles) over the plate everywhere EXCEPT the kept paws' planform (non-plate geometry z < 0.42, closed + filled + dilated 0.05 u), so no paw is trimmed; the plate inside the paw planform stays fused under the soles
light.bake_drop_interior_why: proxy faces with solid on both sides (inner shells under the overlapping scale plates) left out of the bake source so the cage stays tight (drakescale_beast idiom)
light.ao_why: AO baked on the watertight low (the scale-plate soup's inner shells black-hole AO rays); 0.2 u keeps the crevices between the scale plates (drakescale_beast idiom)

recolour3d.name: tone_curve
recolour3d.why: UNIT NOTE (tone: warm brown scales, copper tips, cream belly; tint only). v1 basecolor (albedo x AO) vs the sheet front / side masks: L* p10/50/90 9.8 / 24.8 / 53.3 vs 18.5 / 37.5 / 69.6 and 18.6 / 34.2 / 59.4; the dark band (L* < 25) is 51 % of the texels vs 21-23 % and reads olive (b* 8.2 vs 3.9). The proxy albedo's median re-hued to the sheet's mid scale brown (sheet L* 25-45 median 100,76,65 / 98,73,63) and lifted ~L* +9 so the AO-multiplied basecolor lands on the sheet (offline sim on the v1 bakes: basecolor L* p50 32.6, bands 0.32 / 0.35 / 0.21 / 0.12 vs sheet 0.21-0.23 / 0.42-0.50 / 0.20-0.23 / 0.07-0.14); luminance detail kept (gamma 1.05).

recolour3d.name: tone_cream

segment_array.why: v1.1 (orchestrator V1.1 (1): v1's tail was ~30 % short, chain 3.15 u vs the sheet's ~4.6 u; house rule 'Drakescale Beast v2 tail note': duplicate the generated tail's scale segments, taper to a POINT, never a tube). Source = the cub's OWN tail-root segment under the rump: box x -1.0..0.95, y 1.3..2.65, z 1.45..2.05 (the scaled root: x -0.79..0.63 / y 1.2..2.4 incl. its dorsal spines on +y, stage-1 grid slices; y >= 1.3 stays clear of the hind thighs at |x| 0.66..0.9, y <= 1.1), axis from the slab centre at z 2.05 (x -0.1, y 1.55) to its centre at z 1.45 (y 1.75), 0.63 u; its hollow skin cavity is filled. 9 copies along the SHEET's side-view tail centreline on x = 0 (v1 side registration y = (u - 895.9) / 95, z = (747 - v) / 95: (1070,615) -> (2.12, 1.02)... (1118,680) -> (2.34, 0.705), (1126,710) -> (2.42, 0.42), then the forward curl traced on the sheet side view (1110,760) (1080,785) (1040,800) (1000,808) to the tip (968,815) -> y 2.25 / 1.94 / 1.52 / 1.10 / 0.76); the curl, which the sheet draws below the paw floor line (perspective), is lifted so each copy rests ON the floor (centre z ~ half its thickness, floor_z 0 flattens the contact). The curve starts at the kept root's free end x -0.1 and reaches x = 0 by its third point. Scale 0.95 x 0.88^(i-1) (0.95 .. 0.34), 20 % overlap (the plates shingle), the last copy 2x long with its cross-section ramped to 0.02 = the point at the sheet's tip y 0.76. Array 3.0 u + the kept root 1.3 u = ~4.3 u (sheet ~4.6 u)

config._doc: LIGHT finish of the raw Pixal3D proxy (seed 56, front + side views, sha 57ad4b2d). Points: stage-1 frame (hind paws on the floor, x1.0359 to the sheet front height 5.87, body midline x 0.259 -> 0)

rig.spine_why: hips / belly / chest along the body's mid-height (dorsal max z 3.07 at y 1.0, 3.67 at y 0.0; belly underline z ~1.5..1.8); neck root inside the chest up the neck to the head pivot (0, -2.0, 4.65; behind the eyes y -2.51) -> snout tip (0, -3.22, 4.39)

chains.name: arm
chains.why: the kept front legs (pair A): shoulder (symmetric inside the chest), elbow, wrist and paw centre from z-slab centroids of the +x / -x leg (z 0.15: (0.95, -1.86) / (-0.85, -2.04); z 0.65: (0.77, -1.65) / (-0.80, -1.65); z 1.4: (0.82, -1.53) / (-0.82, -1.53))

chains.name: leg
chains.why: hind legs: hip (symmetric inside the haunch), knee, hock, paw centre from z-slab centroids (z 0.15: (0.88, 0.65) / (-0.91, 0.42); z 0.65: (0.63, 1.07) / (-0.73, 0.92); z 1.4: (0.71, 0.87) / (-0.78, 0.85))

chains.name: tail
chains.why: v1.1: the kept proxy tail root (z >= 1.45, centre ~(-0.1, 1.55, 2.05)) then down the light.segment_array copies' centreline (copy starts (2.07, 1.09) / (2.32, 0.76) / (2.38, 0.42) / (2.07, 0.36) / (1.53, 0.30) / (1.12, 0.22)) to the tip (0.76, 0.12): a 7-bone CENTRED tail chain on x = 0 (mirror false), so the duplicated tail rests on the midline and can be posed to either side. No tail repose target any more: the copies are built on x = 0

clips.why: PLACEHOLDER (movement + in-game height are the open artist questions): idle = breathe + the kit's tail sway; walk = a four-leg step; leg_swing 8 (lesson: the kit walk dips the feet below the floor)

targets.why: artist 2026-10-17: a symmetric rest pose. The kept front legs mirror-symmetric at the mean, both paws planted on the floor (they stood 0.11 u up on the removed shadow plate)
targets.radius_why: [reach, taper] per bone: the drakescale_beast sweep values (the sibling's paws / claws all inside a limb bone)

targets.why: the two hind legs mirror-symmetric at the mean (the -x paw sat 0.23 u ahead of the +x one), both paws planted

targets.heading: -y
targets.why: the face straight ahead (-y): the proxy head is already mirror-symmetric (head mirror p99 0.028 u about its own plane, snout tip x -0.004 after midline_x), so this is ~an identity, stated; the head is RIGID (below)

rigid.why: the head / face (snout, both eyes, jaw line, horn-scale crest; the dense head box) moves as ONE rigid body with the head bone: never deformed or re-sculpted

repose.why: artist 2026-10-17 ('our characters should be symmetrical head turns are done through posing'): the proxy's slightly staggered legs and its tail swung 0.47 u to -x are undone with BONES (proxy_finish_repose), never by mirror-averaging geometry

proxy_faces_cut.rule: proxy faces whose centroid lies inside a light.cuts volume leave the bake source (normal / AO / albedo) and the proxy-distance metrics

segment_array.why: v1.1 (orchestrator V1.1 (1): v1's tail was ~30 % short, chain 3.15 u vs the sheet's ~4.6 u; house rule 'Drakescale Beast v2 tail note': duplicate the generated tail's scale segments, taper to a POINT, never a tube). Source = the cub's OWN tail-root segment under the rump: box x -1.0..0.95, y 1.3..2.65, z 1.45..2.05 (the scaled root: x -0.79..0.63 / y 1.2..2.4 incl. its dorsal spines on +y, stage-1 grid slices; y >= 1.3 stays clear of the hind thighs at |x| 0.66..0.9, y <= 1.1), axis from the slab centre at z 2.05 (x -0.1, y 1.55) to its centre at z 1.45 (y 1.75), 0.63 u; its hollow skin cavity is filled. 9 copies along the SHEET's side-view tail centreline on x = 0 (v1 side registration y = (u - 895.9) / 95, z = (747 - v) / 95: (1070,615) -> (2.12, 1.02)... (1118,680) -> (2.34, 0.705), (1126,710) -> (2.42, 0.42), then the forward curl traced on the sheet side view (1110,760) (1080,785) (1040,800) (1000,808) to the tip (968,815) -> y 2.25 / 1.94 / 1.52 / 1.10 / 0.76); the curl, which the sheet draws below the paw floor line (perspective), is lifted so each copy rests ON the floor (centre z ~ half its thickness, floor_z 0 flattens the contact). The curve starts at the kept root's free end x -0.1 and reaches x = 0 by its third point. Scale 0.95 x 0.88^(i-1) (0.95 .. 0.34), 20 % overlap (the plates shingle), the last copy 2x long with its cross-section ramped to 0.02 = the point at the sheet's tip y 0.76. Array 3.0 u + the kept root 1.3 u = ~4.3 u (sheet ~4.6 u)
segment_array.rule: the proxy segment in `box` copied N times along `curve` (shortest-arc turn onto each chord, uniform scale taper^i, the last copy's cross-section ramped to tip_frac = a point); each copy's pulled-back SDF smooth-unioned into the grid before the remesh; its faces + UVs appended to the bake source; bake faces buried on both sides dropped; originals untouched

high.rule: marching tets of the whole remesh grid (no mirror)

low.method: collapse decimation: uniform to 300000, then 18000 with the dense boxes calibrated

dense.rule: dense boxes weighted 0.02 (vs 1) in the collapse decimation; the factor bisected until the boxes hold density x the rest's triangles per area

ao_fill.rule: AO < below = a bake origin inside the proxy soup: refilled from the covered valid 3x3 neighbours ring by ring (opt-in light.ao_fill_below)

bake.source: the proxy mesh itself (not the remesh)

stretch_all.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

repose.rule: LBS with the contract rig's weights (+ rigid pins), yaw-only straightening (+ lift), applied as rest

stretch_arm.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

stretch_leg.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

stretch_neck_head.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

self_intersections.rule: intersecting triangle pairs sharing no vertex (BVH overlap)

mirror_before.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

mirror_after.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

floor.rule: stage 1 floored the FEET at z 0; the centring puts the lowest point at 0

facing.rule: shell centroid -> the front-most midline point of the shell (proxy finish default)

mirror.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)
